Muyu Cloud Music links libFLAC, libcurl and Mbed TLS.

Copyright (C) 2011-2025 Xiph.Org Foundation. Xiph BSD license (FLAC.txt).

libcurl: Copyright (c) 1996-2026 Daniel Stenberg and contributors.
curl license (curl.txt).

Mbed TLS: Copyright The Mbed TLS Contributors. This distribution elects
Apache License 2.0 from the upstream Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later choice.
Bundled Everest interface: Copyright 2016-2018 INRIA and Microsoft Corporation,
Apache License 2.0. Bundled p256-m: Copyright The Mbed TLS Contributors,
Apache License 2.0 selected. Full upstream license: MbedTLS.txt.

Mozilla CA certificate data: Mozilla Public License 2.0
(Mozilla-CA-MPL-2.0.txt); obtained unmodified from curl's Mozilla CA extract.

The original release source archives for all linked non-system libraries
are included in the accompanying source distribution under vendor/archives.
Apple system frameworks, SQLite and zlib are provided by the target OS;
Apple SDK/toolchain files are not redistributed in this application.
